hints.content:
We can make a right triangle where the hypotenuse of the triangle is the given line. We can represent the length of the line with $\greenD x$:


[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: The first quadrant of an x- y- coordinate plane. A line segment extends from two, eight to twelve, two. A vertical dashed line extends from two, eight six units and horizontally ten units to twelve, two to form a right triangle. The hypotenuse is x.

hints.content:
Now we can use the Pythagorean theorem to find $\greenD x$:

$\begin{align} \maroonD a^2 + \maroonD b^2 &= \greenD x^2 ~~~~~~~~~\small\gray{\text{The Pythagorean theorem}}\\\\
\maroonD{6}^2 + \maroonD{10}^2 &= \greenD{x}^2 ~~~~~~~~~~\small\gray{\text{Plug in the side lengths}}\\\\
36+ 100&= \greenD x^2 ~~~~~~~~~~\small\gray{\text{Evaluate } 6^2 \text{ and }  10^2}\\\\
136&= \greenD x^2~~~~~~~~~~\small\gray{\text{Add 36 and 100}}\\\\
\greenD x &=\sqrt{136}~~~~\small\gray{\text{Take the square root of each side}}\\\\ \\\end{align}$

###The answer

The length of the line is $\sqrt{136}$ units.
